note: Facts about each image format, written once. scripts/build-pair-pages.mjs combines two of them into the comparison table on each converter page. Keep every value true for the Free Image Converter as it is today.

jpg.label: JPG
jpg.opens: Every app, browser and upload form

jfif.label: JFIF
jfif.compression: Lossy: a JPEG with another ending
jfif.opens: Most viewers, but many upload forms reject the .jfif ending

webp.label: WebP
webp.compression: Lossy or lossless: small web files
webp.opens: Browsers; many older apps and forms can't

gif.label: GIF
gif.transparency: On or off, no soft edges

svg.label: SVG
svg.opens: Browsers and design tools; many apps and forms can't

ico.label: ICO
ico.compression: Several small PNG icons in one file
ico.opens: Windows, and browsers as a favicon

heic.label: HEIC
heic.opens: Apple devices; Windows and many sites can't

pdf.label: PDF
pdf.compression: A document page holding the image
pdf.opens: Every computer and phone, and document forms
